title: Kestrel Delivery Plan Terms: Cancelling a Delivery & Pickup Services Plan
content:
A Delivery & Pickup Services plan is cancelled only at the patient's own request, which the patient confirms themselves.

## Terms

1. A plan cancelled while still enrolled in its free trial is never charged.
2. Where the plan's cancellation takes effect at the end of the billing cycle, the plan keeps its prices until the end of the paid cycle, and the cancellation effective date is the cycle's end date.
3. Where the plan's cancellation takes effect immediately, the cancellation takes effect the same day.
4. Orders already placed are delivered at the prices in force when they were placed.
5. Refunds of a subscription fee follow the subscription fee refund terms.

## By plan

| Plan | Cancellation takes effect |
|---|---|
| Kestrel Delivery Pass Monthly, Kestrel Senior Delivery Pass | at the end of the paid billing cycle; plan prices apply until then |
| Kestrel Pay-Per-Delivery, Kestrel Mail Delivery, Kestrel Delivery Pass Annual, Kestrel Specialty Courier Service | the same day |

## Hypothetical cases

- A patient on Kestrel Delivery Pass Monthly whose paid cycle runs to 14 June cancels on 3 June: the cancellation effective date is 14 June, and orders up to then are priced as Delivery Pass orders.
- A patient on Kestrel Delivery Pass Annual cancels on 3 June: the cancellation takes effect on 3 June.
- A patient still in the free trial of Kestrel Senior Delivery Pass cancels: no subscription fee is ever charged on the plan.
- A same-day order placed on 2 June and delivered on 4 June, after an immediate cancellation on 3 June, is delivered at the prices in force on 2 June.
